title: Record a lab order
summary: Enter a job for the lab: patient, services with teeth, doctor, lab and notes.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Service
steps.details: Pick the job from the lab services list. You can add several; if it does not exist, create it from here.

steps.title: Teeth
steps.details: The teeth for that service. The order’s teeth are the sum of all its services.

steps.title: Service note
steps.details: Shade, material or any instruction for the lab.

steps.title: Doctor
steps.details: Who requested the job; the order’s alerts go to them.

steps.title: Lab
steps.details: Optional now: if you skip it, it is asked for when the order is sent. Only providers in a lab category show up.

steps.title: Attachments
steps.details: Photos, PDFs or 3D scans for the lab; they are uploaded when the order is created.

steps.title: Urgent
steps.details: If you turn it on, it comes first in the list, on the board and in the patient file.

steps.title: Create the order
steps.details: It starts in the initial stage with no due date: the date is asked for when it is sent to the lab.
